bibl.title: Il papiro in una "lista di spesa" dall'Agora e nella commedia greca.
bibl.seg: Menico Caroli, Il papiro in una "lista di spesa" dall'Agora e nella commedia greca.
bibl.note: A fragment of a "shopping list" from the Athenian Agora, edited by: Mabel Lang, Graffiti and Dipinti = Athenian Agora. XXI (Princeton, 1976) p. 10, No. B14 (IV-III B.C.), but not studied so far as an evidence on Athenian book trade, suggests to place the sale of papyrus, already evoked by Eupolis (fr. 327 K.-A.), in a market area close to the so-called Orchestra. The historical value of the fragment is confirmed by some passages of Attic comedy, and by archaeological evidence.
